reuse.why: Link rules go through one new prepareBankAccountLink helper used by every provider, unlinkAccount's reset is reused via clearAccountBankLink, and the Akahu download is generalised for Fintegra; but the Fintegra link copies Akahu's link body instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: linkBankSyncAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount (upgrade/insert/sync/notify) while linkAkahuAccount keeps its own copy, adding a sixth copy of the link body.

placement.why: Link rules live in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers, download logic in sync.ts, URL in server-config, types in types/models, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps, though the 'generic' linkBankSyncAccount and the client provider entries go slightly beyond the server-only Fintegra step.

maintainability.why: A single guard for the link rules is easy to own; the generic linker that only Fintegra uses leaves two parallel implementations of the same flow.

disguised_duplication.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount: generalised (provider parameter) copy of linkAkahuAccount, which is not migrated onto it

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink gained replaceExistingLink (step 4) and a closed-account check (step 3, a general rule, not a caller special case); all five provider link handlers and the new one call it
